# Anabhi Dev

> Personal developer brand based in Bali, Indonesia. Building high-performance websites, automation systems, and AI-powered products for hospitality operations, enterprise management, and lifestyle sectors.

## Key Platforms & Ecosystem

- [Anabhi Dev Roadmap](https://roadmap.anabhidev.com/): Master visual portfolio roadmap tracking 85 projects across Personal (51), Office (31), and Shared platforms (3). Features live status, technology stack filtering, and system catalog.
- [Engineering Lab](https://labs.anabhidev.com/): Living engineering workshop behind anabhidev.com — project registry, development timeline, technical insights, and experiment logs.
- [Knowledge Hub & Learn Guides](https://anabhidev.com/learn.html): Curated collection of 12 production-grade guides on AI tools, Claude Code architecture, prompt engineering, and developer workflows.
- [Portfolio Directory](https://anabhidev.com/portfolio.html): Complete archive of websites, client projects, SaaS platforms, and enterprise hospitality solutions built by Anabhi Dev.
- [BaliEats AI](https://anabhidev.com/BaliEats-AI/): AI-powered Bali culinary assistant. Traditional Balinese food, street food, seafood, vegetarian options, nutritional analysis of food photos, Bali food calendar by ceremony, and restaurant recommendations by area.
- [Career Suite](https://anabhidev.com/Career-Suite/): Comprehensive suite of 5 tools for job seekers and recruiters (CV Analyzer, CV Screener, Salary benchmark, Career path, Interview prep).
- [Child Smart Play](https://anabhidev.com/Child-Smart-Play/): Interactive educational games for children covering mathematics, language, and logic.

## Technical Guides & AI Workflows

- [Claude Model Selection Guide](https://anabhidev.com/tips/Claude-Model.html): In-depth comparative analysis of Claude 3.7 Sonnet, Opus, Haiku, and Fable — token economics, reasoning effort levels, and task-based architectural routing.
- [Skills, Connectors & Plugins Guide](https://anabhidev.com/tips/skills.html): Interactive catalog explaining Anthropic Claude directory components, automated trigger behaviors vs explicit slash commands, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations.
- [Dual-Account Claude Code Setup](https://anabhidev.com/tips/VSC-Claude.html): Step-by-step configuration for isolating enterprise and personal Claude Code accounts on Windows using VS Code Insiders and `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`.
- [Claude Code & Vibe Coding Guide](https://anabhidev.com/tips/tips-001.html): Best practices for agentic coding in CLI and VS Code, `.claudeignore` strategies, and context window optimization.
- [ChatGPT Master Guide](https://anabhidev.com/tips/tips-002.html): Practical productivity techniques, custom instructions, and structured workflows.
- [Gemini + Google Workspace](https://anabhidev.com/tips/tips-003.html): AI integration with Docs, Sheets, and Gmail for business efficiency.
- [Google Apps Script Automation](https://anabhidev.com/tips/tips-004.html): Serverless workflow automation and custom API webhooks on Google Cloud infrastructure.
- [Git & GitHub Professional Workflows](https://anabhidev.com/tips/tips-005.html): Safe staging repositories, branch strategies, and deployment scripts.
- [Modern VS Code Configuration](https://anabhidev.com/tips/tips-006.html): Workspace settings, essential extensions, and keybinding optimization.
- [Python for Automation](https://anabhidev.com/tips/tips-007.html): Scripting for data manipulation, spreadsheet workflows, and scheduled tasks.
- [Modern Vanilla JavaScript](https://anabhidev.com/tips/tips-008.html): Lightweight, high-performance DOM manipulation, async patterns, and accessible UI components without heavy framework bloat.
- [Notion Second Brain & Databases](https://anabhidev.com/tips/tips-009.html): Relational databases, formula optimization, and project tracking systems.

## About the Author

- [Anabhi Dev Profile](https://anabhidev.com/): Developer profile by I Gede Agus Wibawa, based in Denpasar, Bali, Indonesia. 15 years of hospitality IT experience building lightweight, reliable web solutions, Google Apps Script automation, Gemini API integrations, and Cloudflare Pages deployments.
